The recipe is the triage's, unchanged, so that a source reaching "transformed" there reaches it here. ``compiled`` is not the transform's own ``--compile`` result. That one runs inside the output directory and answers a question no job asks; see :func:`job_layout_compile`, which compiles over the file set a job is handed. Both are recorded -- ``compiled`` from the job layout, ``compiled_in_output_dir`` from the transform's own -- so that a future divergence between them is in the data rather than waiting to be found.
